**Work Done in Physics:**

 
• Work done is a fundamental concept in physics that refers to the transfer of energy when a force is applied to an object and the object moves in the direction of the force. It is a scalar quantity and is measured in joules (J) in the International System of Units (SI).

**Work done = Force × Displacement × cos(θ)**
